findings.suggested_fix: Add an 'HMS-4 REQ-10' API test that the list stays newest first. Trace REQ-12 to the PAT-8 test and REQ-15 to the start-instant test, or explain under Known why they are left out.
findings.text: REQ-10 (sort order unchanged, S-3 AC3) has no HMS-4 test and is missing from the trace. The strategy wants a test named with each requirement's ID. REQ-12 and REQ-15 are also left out of the trace without a note.

cites.quote: API tests check the list envelope (20 per page), search and the filter error are unchanged

findings.suggested_fix: Change the Known wording to 'page_size is 20', or add a test with more than 20 patients that checks page 2 still carries last_visit_at.
findings.text: Known says the API tests check '20 per page', but the paging test only checks page_size: 20 on a one-row search result. Paging with more than 20 patients is never run.

findings.suggested_fix: Seed the Completed visit each test needs inside that test or in beforeAll, so no test relies on another test's side effects.
findings.text: The first API describe block shares one database across its tests. The REQ-4 and REQ-8/REQ-9 tests depend on the visit the REQ-2 test creates earlier, so they fail if run alone or in a different order.

findings.suggested_fix: Also assert that the cell shows the Kolkata date (28 Oct) and not the UTC date (27 Oct).
findings.text: The hospital-zone test builds its expected text with the same dateTime helper the page uses. A bug in dateTime would pass unnoticed, and the test never checks the 28 Oct date that the comment says matters.

rubric_items.reason: Tests cover the changed repo query and the Last visit column: latest Completed, the status filter, null and '-', and the zone. REQ-10 (sort order) has no HMS-4 test and is left out of the trace.

Assertions check what callers can see: last_visit_at values, status codes, headers and cell text. The paging check is weak because total is 1, and the zone check builds its expected text with the same dateTime helper.

Covers the invalid filter returning 400 with a field error, a patient with only a Cancelled appointment, no visit, cross-patient leakage and the UTC/Kolkata date boundary. It never runs paging with more than 20 patients.

API tests use Vitest and Supertest with a throwaway PostgreSQL and a fixed clock. Web tests use jsdom and Testing Library. The files sit in the existing layout and test names start with the requirement IDs.
States no test counts or coverage, defers to the verifier and records that coverage is skipped. It openly flags that the API tests may be skipped without PostgreSQL (Q-01).
